title.narrative: Regional Project on Takaful for Resilience and Financial Inclusion in the Arab States

description.narrative: In recent years, inclusive insurance - including Shariah-compliant Takaful - has emerged as an important enabler of economic resilience, social protection, and financial inclusion across the Arab States. By pooling risks and providing affordable protection against shocks, Takaful can help households, micro and small enterprises, and farmers manage climate, health, and economic risks, while supporting livelihoods and entrepreneurship.
